verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own isolation pattern: separate projects with per-environment token switching so testing data does not contaminate production, and its partner guide includes a 'Setting up a Sandbox' section that uses a free account as a sandbox. This is real data isolation, not a dry-run, but it is not a dedicated sandbox or test mode, and the docs state there is no API-level test-mode parameter. missing for 10: a first-class sandbox/test mode or API test flag, documented provisioning of sandbox environments for agent workflows (e.g. via MCP), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Keep development data out of production by using separate Mixpanel projects and switching tokens per environment
Sign up for a free Mixpanel account, which you can use as a sandbox when building and testing your integration.
